caption: The drawing depicts a single object in the shape of a fish, oriented with its head positioned on the left and its body curved toward the right. The fish features a rounded head with a circular eye and two grooves marking the gill area. Its mouth is slightly open, indicated by a curved line. The body of the fish is textured with a series of overlapping, scale-like shapes, and it has prominent, ridged pectoral, dorsal, and caudal fins. The caudal fin (tail fin) is spread and partially overlaps the lower edge of the body, while the dorsal fin is positioned along the back, showing defined ridges. The fish is rendered in a monochromatic, grayish tone, suggesting it might be made of a solid or metallic material. The background is a plain, light color, which provides a neutral contrast to the darker coloration of the fish-shaped object. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the composition.
title: Aspic Mold
